description:
Make archive execute read prior executions from the target's evidence record, once, instead of parsing the event log twice.

## Background

Execute captures the whole event log (`capture_archive_base`, `crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs`) and parses it twice from the image: in the planner (`commands/archive.rs`) and in the finalizer (`finalize_archive_execution`, `repository_state/archive.rs`), both through `captured_archive_events` (`pub(crate)`, re-exported from `repository_state/mod.rs`), which fails as `ArchiveExecutionError::EventLog`. Each target's executions are in `archive-evidence/<target-key>.json`, which execute captures.

Kept as one change for a build reason: the planner and the finalizer are the only callers of `captured_archive_events`, and unused crate-private code fails the zero-warning build, so the function, its re-export and the error variant it alone produces go with them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Execute reads the target's evidence record once from its image, the finalizer receives it from the planner, and `BaseCapturePurpose::Archive` captures the event log as a tail, so `capture_proposed_base_inner` has no whole-log arm and `capture_archive_base`'s doc comment says so.
- [hard] REQ-02: `captured_archive_events`, its re-export and `ArchiveExecutionError::EventLog` no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test shows that execute of a re-archived target succeeds with an unparseable event log and produces the same coverage and residue identities as before.
title: Archive execute reads the per-target evidence record
